label: 付款逾期使合同失效
description: 当前时间超过订阅费支付请求（request.payment）的截止时间，且请求与订阅合同（contract.subscription）不一致或期限内没有恰好一份匹配的合格付款证明（role.payment-proof）时，判定订阅费支付履约（fulfillment.payment）逾期。
expression:
now > request.expired_at && !(request.subscription_id ==
agreement.subscription_id && request.reader_id ==
agreement.reader_id && request.column_id == agreement.column_id &&
request.currency == agreement.currency && request.amount_minor_units
== agreement.amount_minor_units && request.amount_minor_units > 0 &&
proofs.filter(p, p.subscription_id == request.subscription_id &&
p.reader_id == request.reader_id && p.column_id == request.column_id
&& p.payment_request_id == request.request_id &&
p.amount_minor_units == request.amount_minor_units && p.currency ==
request.currency && p.success && p.confirmed_at >=
request.started_at && p.confirmed_at <= request.expired_at).size()
== 1)
